prompt: A wounded soldier in dented, soot-stained steel plate armor kneels slumped in side profile, a deep bleeding gash across his side, his face tilted up in relief. A column of warm golden-white healing light descends from above and bathes him, and the gash is visibly knitting shut, raw flesh closing under the glow. The only source of light in the scene is this soft, radiant, magical healing light. The background is a dim, ruined stone battlefield at dusk.

A fallen, wounded knight lies sprawled on a dark, smoke-filled battlefield at night. A sudden radiant burst of warm golden-white healing light erupts over his body, crepuscular rays fanning out, color returning to his pale face as his wounds close. The only source of light is the magical healing burst. The background is a dim ruined field of broken spears and shadowed earth.
